verdict.rationale: Docs describe a diff view with keyboard navigation through changed files, draft PR creation triggered from that diff view, and task/session artifacts that reviewers can comment on before work proceeds — directly matching the review-then-approve-then-PR workflow. Community sentiment corroborates the human-approval-before-autonomous-action pattern, though there is no independent hands-on account of the specific diff-review-to-approve-to-PR flow. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the exact review-approve-then-create-PR sequence, and explicit documentation of an approval gate/button distinct from just viewing the diff.
